obligations: Accept only registered, identified, versioned operational summary envelopes.
Preserve source report identifiers, project identity, producer identity, timestamps, and evidence references.
Never ingest raw databases, raw business records, credentials, secrets, or unbounded payloads.
Support Ultra Brain, Core Meta OS, Registry, Validation, Release, OS Ecosystem, project, and database status domains.
Support error, failure, incident, warning, recovery, and rollback findings without rewriting source history.
Rank recommendations transparently and mark consequential actions as approval required.
Treat approval, Automation execution, recovery, rollback, and outcome reporting as separate authority transitions.
Return advisory briefs and result reports without autonomous execution.
failure_semantics: Unknown source, missing identity, missing evidence, malformed summary, secret-bearing data, or authority ambiguity fails closed.
